notes.title: Update 1.2 - New Bonus Gallery and improved visuals!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926505/d271be77101c422068c3953b54b6f005b73c8c82.png[/img]We added a brand new[b] bonus gallery[/b], accessible from the main menu after you complete the game. It features hot naked images of the main character, e-girl Lilly.

We also fixed some small bugs and improved[b] visuals of the game[/b] - change fonts, gui graphics and other tweaks to make the game more appealing as well as easy to read!

Hope you'll like the update, let us now what we should work on next on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4nKgsfgwA8]Discord[/url]!
